test_methods_and_attributes: test pybind11 methods and attributes including instance creation, method calls, value properties, and constructor stats
test_copy_method: test copying pybind11 methods to class attributes and calling them on instances
test_properties: test pybind11 instance properties including readonly, readwrite, property, and writeonly attributes
test_static_properties: test pybind11 static properties including readonly, readwrite, writeonly, and property variants on classes and instances
test_dynamic_attributes: test dynamically adding and removing attributes on pybind11 bound classes with __dict__ support
